faq.a: Mariama is associated with the Arabic form مَرْيَم, whose core sense is mariama; mary (west african form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Mariama?
faq.a: Mariama is associated with Arabic. Mariama is the West African form of Arabic مَرْيَم (Maryam), the Quranic form of Mary.
Yes — the underlying form مَرْيَم is Arabic.
Mariama can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Mariama should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Maryam is the Quranic Arabic form of Mary and occurs in the Quran.

faq.q: What does Mariama mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Mariama is rendered مریم and carries the sense مریم، حضرت مریم.

faq.q: What are the variants of Mariama?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Mariama, mariama. Script forms are مريم, مریم, مَرْيَم, मरियमा.

faq.q: Is Mariama a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
